title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 2: the king sends Nehemiah to Jerusalem, where he inspects the walls by night.

questions.text: In which month did the narrator bring wine to the king?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:1 says it was in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes, that "I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king."

questions.text: How did the narrator feel when the king asked why his face was sad?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:2 says, "Then I was very much afraid."

questions.text: What did the narrator do right after the king asked, "What is your request?"
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:4 says, "So I prayed to the God of heaven."

answers.text: He prayed to the God of heaven
He asked for time to think
He called for his brother Hanani

questions.text: Who was sitting by the king when he asked how long the journey would be?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:6 says the queen was also sitting by him.

questions.text: To whom did the narrator ask for a letter so that he could get timber?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:8 asks for a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the king's forest, to give timber.

answers.text: The captains of the king's army
Asaph, the keeper of the king's forest

questions.text: Whom had the king sent with the narrator?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:9 says the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen "with me."

answers.text: Captains of the army and horsemen

questions.text: How is Sanballat described in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:10 calls him Sanballat the Horonite.

questions.text: By which gate did the narrator go out at night to inspect the walls?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:13 says, "I went out by night by the valley gate."

questions.text: What problem did the narrator have near the spring gate and the king's pool?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:14 says there was no place for the animal under him to pass.

answers.text: There was no place for his animal to pass
The guards would not let him through
The pool was full of soldiers
It was too dark to see anything

questions.text: What did the narrator tell Sanballat, Tobiah and Geshem they had in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:20 says, "you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem."
